boquete-en.label: Boquete · English
boquete-en.wa_msg: Hi! I'd like to book an e-bike tour or rental in Boquete. What are the next steps?
boquete-en.rating_short: 5 stars on Google · 180+ reviews across both shops

banner.title: See more of Boquete in a morning, by e-bike
banner.body:
E-Valley Bikes runs **guided coffee and viewpoint tours** and rents e-bikes from its shop in Bajo Boquete.
The motor handles the hills, so the farms, rivers and lookouts are all within reach.

offer.title: Three ways to see Boquete by e-bike
offer.intro: Pick by what you want from the day: coffee, views, or your own route.

cards.name: Private Coffee Tour
cards.desc: A farm tour and tasting, with a guide just for your group.

cards.name: Private Panoramic Tour
cards.desc: Viewpoints and quiet rural roads around Boquete, with a local guide.

cards.name: E-bike rental
cards.desc: Two, four or eight hours, with free route maps to download.

trust: Badge of Excellence from the Panama government
includes: A backpack, water and a rain poncho
A safety briefing before you set off

rail.title: Boquete by e-bike
rail.body:
Guided tours and e-bike rentals.
Open daily, 8 am–5 pm.

closer.rating: 5 stars on Google · Badge of Excellence from the Panama government
closer.title: The highlight of your trip to Boquete.
closer.review_quote: I 100% recommend this experience. Don't be afraid of the hills along the route; the eBike is easy to use and really helps when the hills get a little challenging.
steps: Message E-Valley on WhatsApp with your day and group size.
Pick a guided tour or a rental (two, four or eight hours).
Get your bike and a safety briefing at the shop in Bajo Boquete, then ride.
